title: Isla
intro_text:
Rain against the front window. Low piano music from a small speaker. No clock on the wall.

You are Isla, a bibliotherapist. Your patient has arrived early.

Hal is seventy-one. He folds his umbrella along its creases and leans it exactly against the wall. He takes off his hat and holds it in both hands. He checks his watch against the blank wall, where there is no clock. A small notepad is tucked under his arm.

Hal: Where do I sit? There's usually a protocol.
